sources.role: config/save path resolution and savegame naming

paths.path: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/scummvm/scummvm.ini, default ~/.config/scummvm/scummvm.ini (legacy ~/.scummvmrc still honored; -c <file> selects a private config)
$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/scummvm/scummvm.ini, default ~/.config/scummvm/scummvm.ini (or -c <file> private config)
paths.naming: [keymapper] and per-target INI domains store keymap_<keymap-id>_<action-id> = <space-separated hardware input ids>; default engine keymap actions include LCLK, RCLK, PAUSE, MENU, SKIP, SKLI, PIND, RETURN, UP, DOWN, LEFT and RIGHT

paths.path: savepath key (Paths tab), default $XDG_DATA_HOME/scummvm/saves i.e. ~/.local/share/scummvm/saves (legacy ~/.scummvm while it exists; SCUMMVM_SAVEPATH env or --savepath override)
paths.naming: Per-target savegames named <target>.NNN (e.g. target.001) for engines with kSimpleSavesNames, <target>.sNN (e.g. target.s01) otherwise — one numbered file per slot in the target's id, plus an autosave slot (autosave every 5 minutes by default)
evidence: docs:save_load_games Linux paths and autosave interval

paths.path: None — ScummVM has no save-state facility; progress is kept only through the engine savegames above
paths.naming: Not applicable: no state files exist; the engine-default keymap exposes no state actions
evidence: contract:docs/SCUMMVM_NATIVE_CONTROLLER_CONTRACT.md (engine-default keymap action list has no save-state action)

paths.path: No BIOS required; a few engines want extra data files (extras) reachable via the extrapath setting / Paths tab in addition to the game data
paths.naming: No external BIOS filename or canonical checksum: optional engine data is an extrapath directory, whose exact files are engine/game-specific
evidence: docs:configuration_file paths table (extrapath: "Extra path for additional game data")

paths.path: not applicable
paths.naming: ScummVM does not consume an external cryptographic key file.

linux.notes: Lunchbox launches with -c <ini> and a private XDG_CONFIG_HOME so the ini and keymap domains stay in the session while savepath continues to point at the user's save directory.

paths.path: ~/.var/app/org.scummvm.ScummVM/config/scummvm/scummvm.ini (flatpak points XDG_CONFIG_HOME at the per-app ~/.var/app dir)
~/.var/app/org.scummvm.ScummVM/config/scummvm/scummvm.ini
paths.naming: Same [keymapper] and per-target keymap_<keymap-id>_<action-id> = <hardware ids> grammar as native; default actions are engine-default_* entries

paths.path: ~/.var/app/org.scummvm.ScummVM/data/scummvm/saves (XDG_DATA_HOME redirected per app)
paths.naming: <target>.NNN or <target>.sNN per save slot, named for the game target id, plus the autosave slot

paths.path: None — no save states on any platform
paths.naming: Not applicable: no state files exist

paths.path: No BIOS required; engine extras (extrapath) may be needed inside the sandbox
paths.naming: No external BIOS filename or canonical checksum; optional engine-specific data is supplied through the extrapath directory

paths.path: not applicable
paths.naming: ScummVM does not consume an external cryptographic key file.

paths.path: %APPDATA%\ScummVM\Saved games (portable mode: <exe dir>\Saved games); savepath can be set globally or per target in scummvm.ini
paths.naming: <target>.NNN or <target>.sNN per save slot, named for the game target id, plus the autosave slot
